ContactType.Desc.781040201: Owner of a glittering casino that attracts both the high and the low.
BlockDesc.781041402_Male: I received a curious message from the owner of the Boston Common Casino.
BlockDesc.781041402_Female: I received a curious message from the owner of the Boston Common Casino.
Dialog.D_AhabSyndication_CasinoOwner_Int: The casino is owned by {1} but rumors say it is a front for the <style=DialogName>Seven Dragons</style> syndicate.
The casino is owned by {1} but rumors say it is a front for the <style=DialogName>Seven Dragons</style> syndicate.
<style=DialogName>Seven Dragons</style> specializes in financial crimes, don't they?
Everything from extortion to counterfeiting to white-collar fraud.
But their real strength is investment in legitimate businesses.
They generally keep a low profile and launder their illegal proceeds through some of their businesses.
A casino would be a particularly good place to launder money, as well as a source for identifying and scoping out potential targets.
Now the owner, {1}, wants to talk to you.
Now the owner, {1}, wants to talk to you.
Let's see what he wants to talk about.
Let's see what she wants to talk about.
Hello, Hello! It's good to meet you, {1}
Hello, Hello! It's good to meet you, {1}
Hello, {6}. I've heard you want to talk to me.
Hello, {6}. I've heard you want to talk to me.
I do indeed. News of a new <style=DialogName>Cyber Knight</style> in town spreads quickly.
You, my friend, are going to be a mover and shaker in this city.
I make it my business to get to know movers and shakers.
I'd like to invite you to visit the Boston Common Casino.
You can meet so many interesting people there. Corp Vice Presidents and Gray Cards, MilSec agents and, shall we say, less legitimate persons.
It sounds like a lot of people there would like to see me dead.
No need to worry about security - we have a very strict policy about disputes within our walls, and plenty of enforcers.
We have made deals across the entire Zone. The Boston Common Casino is neutral ground.
The casino lives up to its namesake, a Common where New Boston can meet.
And we have a high-stakes game open only to the elite, the movers and shakers. People like you, {1}.
And we have a high-stakes game open only to the elite, the movers and shakers. People like you, {1}.
As you might expect, the game is popular, so I could only fit you in about once a month.
Call me if you are interested in buying into one of these game sessions. Maybe you can win the pot.
We can find {1} in our Contact list to check out what additional services and offerings he may be able to provide.
We can find {1} in our Contact list to check out what additional services and offerings she may be able to provide.
To join the high-stakes game, click on the Chat box in his profile.
To join the high-stakes game, click on the Chat box in her profile.
Participation in the game is limited to no more than once a month.

StoryNode.SN_AhabSyndication_LegRailmast: {0} is following rumors about a special sale by Ricksham Syndicate.
BlockDesc.781041102: Have you heard the rumor about a special sale by Ricksham Syndicate?
BlockDesc.781041103: If you don't hurry, the special sale will be over!
BlockDesc.781041105: What do you think will be on sale?
BlockDesc.781041106: Why would Ricksham have a sale?
BlockDesc.781041107: This sounds intriguing. We will start following the rumors.
BlockDesc.781041109_Male: Chasing rumors isn't what we specialize in.
BlockDesc.781041109_Female: Chasing rumors isn't what we specialize in.
BlockDesc.781041111_Male: I have set up a meeting with the Ricksham Railmaster.
BlockDesc.781041111_Female: I have set up a meeting with the Ricksham Railmaster.
Dialog.D_AhabSyndication_LegRailmaster_I: No, we haven't heard anything. What have you heard?
No, we haven't heard anything. What have you heard?
It's hard to find any facts, but Ricksham may be setting up some kind of special sale.
Some rare products they have come across. And the sale will have a limited audience.
If they have weapons, I want to see them.
I'm always looking for good gear.
I'd love a new weapon for my collection.
Whatever it is, I want it!
What would you like us to do?
Track down the rumors. Find out who is running this sale so I can try to get in.
Someone has to know, and I think you can find out.
Dialog.D_AhabSyndication_LegRailmaster_L: Just ask around and follow the rumors. No need for any coercion.
Anyone who knows anything is keeping it close to their chest.
You will have to go digging deep to find anything.
Dialog.D_AhabSyndication_LegRailmaster_C: I think it's either weapons or weapon mods.
Ricksham is keeping a tight lid on any real information.
A good question. Ricksham usually doesn't do distribution.
They pass their goods along to others to distribute.
My guess is they have some new source and they are feeling out the market.
Dialog.D_AhabSyndication_LegRailmaster_W: It took a lot of prying, and some cash to loosen tongues.
I finally tracked the rumors down.
The person running this big sale is named {1}.
The person running this big sale is named {1}.
{6} is a Railmaster for Ricksham Syndicate.
{6} is a Railmaster for Ricksham Syndicate.
The Railmaster runs Ricksham operations in the rail yard.
Then that's who I have to talk to.
Thank you! I have some calls to make.
Thanks. Rumors are not exactly my forte.
We may have to look into this sale ourselves.
We may have to look into this sale ourselves.
{1}, see if you can set up a meeting.
{1}, see if you can set up a meeting.
Dialog.D_AhabSyndication_LegRailmaster_M: All right. Let's meet {1} now.
All right. Let's meet {1} now.
Well, this is a surprise. A <style=DialogName>Cyber Knight</style>!
What brings you to the rail yards?
We have heard that you are about to hold an exclusive sale.
We thought we would look into the rumors.
You must have good contacts. We are keeping that quite secret.
Yes, we are starting a special sale soon.
We have connected with a supplier out in Phoenix making reproductions of rare weapon mods.
Knock-off weapon mods?
These are quality goods, they just don't have the manufacturer's stamp on them.
They clearly have a good blueprint forger and access to a decent NanoFab.
Yes, we would be interested in that.
I think I can extend an invitation for a <style=DialogName>Cyber Knight</style>.
Since we have a limited supply, you will be restricted to one purchase a month.
Oh, and you should meet {1}; he runs security for the shipments.
Oh, and you should meet {1}; she runs security for the shipments.
Thank you. I'm looking forward to seeing what you have.
We can find {1} in our Contact list to check out what additional services and offerings {3} may be able to provide.
To find the special weapon mods, filter the Market to gear sold by {1}.
To find the special weapon mods, filter the Market to gear sold by {1}.
After purchasing from the Reproduction Weapon Mods services, there will be a cooldown of 30 days before you can use the services again.
